title: Hangboard Protocol Load Goal Adherence by Grip Type
dataSources: Kaya sessions (`kaya:session`), MoonBoard sessions (`moonboard:session`), Tension Board sessions (`tensionboard:session`), 8a.nu sends (`eighta:send`), hangboard protocols (`hangboard:protocol`).
app: Kaya app sessions, MoonBoard and Tension Board logs, 8a.nu send history, and hangboard protocol trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hangboard:protocol
| stats avg(load_kg) as actual count as sessions by grip_type
| eval pct_of_goal=round(100*actual/20.0,1), goal_label="20"
| sort pct_of_goal
description: Compares average added load in kilograms with a simple target for each grip type, showing where hangboard protocol load is meeting plan and where it is lagging.
value: Splitting target adherence by grip type shows which contexts are helping you hit the plan and which ones need adjustment.
implementation: Set the target value in the query to match your routine, then review low-adherence grip type values before the next session block.
visualization: Table of grip type values with average added load in kilograms and percent of goal.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers which grip type settings help you hit your target for hangboard protocol load and which ones fall short.
